It's starting to get hot around here, what do you do when it's hot outside?
How do you beat the heat?

When it gets this hot I generally try only to change planning methods instead of cutting out the things I tend to enjoy doing because of the climate here. I generally try to plan my strenuous activities like running or hiking for early morning times and change the gear I carry. A little bit before sunrise is best (if you're hiking it makes for some great photo opportunities if you manage to summit quickly enough). If early isn't an option, I try not to say "oh well, another time" but instead scale back intensity. For example: I'm a slow runner already - 9 minute miles when it's nice out - so I don't mind too much if I have to shoot for 10-11 minute miles. It certainly beats sitting inside doing nothing all day.

For everything else - just keep hydrated and don't be afraid to hop in the shower more than once a day if you're one of those folks that sweat a ton like myself.
